import csv

items.prior:
## How credits work in Chimera

Chimera is a pool of computers that run AI models for each other. Credits keep it fair.

**Earning.** When your computer is lending and someone else's work runs on it, you earn credits: about one credit per thousand tokens a mid-size model writes, and more for bigger models, since they cost more to run. If you share a Head, such as an image generator, you also earn a bonus each time someone else uses it, and another when they rate the result four or five stars.

**Spending.** When your messages run on someone else's computer, you pay at the same rates. Work on your own devices is always free.

Everyone starts with some credits, so you can try things before you lend anything.
items.critique: It never explains what happens when your balance goes below zero (other people's computers stop taking your work; your own devices still run it for free), and at about 150 words it's far short of the 600 asked for. The earning section is clear and accurate; keep it.
items.notes: Round-2 re-plan of a writing task: keep the earning section, add what's missing.
